points.quote: for student assignments you should seek prior approval of your module coordinator before using GenAI Tools, ref. Section 4.3, UCD Academic Integrity Policy
points.gist: For student assignments, seek prior approval from your module coordinator before using GenAI tools.

points.quote: First and foremost, you should never rely on AI to create content for your academic work without appropriate acknowledgement
points.gist: Never rely on AI to create content for academic work without appropriate acknowledgement.

points.quote: When you do use AI generated content you must acknowledge its use with proper attribution and citation.
points.gist: AI-generated content used must be acknowledged with proper attribution and citation.

points.quote: Module Coordinators must also provide adequate guidance for students on the use of AI for assessment within their modules
points.gist: Module Coordinators must give students adequate guidance on AI use for assessment in their modules.

points.quote: The Library also advises that you consult the University's AI Governance Principles for additional information.
points.gist: The Library advises consulting the University's AI Governance Principles for more information.

points.quote: You should also be aware that AI content is not entirely reliable.
points.gist: AI content is not entirely reliable.

points.quote: Responsible use of generative AI also includes developing an understanding of the environmental and socioeconomic impacts that result from the use of AI tools.
points.gist: Responsible use includes understanding the environmental and socioeconomic impacts of AI tools.

points.quote: you want to “Outsource Academic labour to AI, not thinking”.
points.gist: Outsource academic labour to AI, not thinking (quoting Mushtaq Bilal).

points.quote: It is best to think of AI as a personal assistant. Use it to help clarify your ideas, structure your arguments and familiarise yourself with new topics.
points.gist: Think of AI as a personal assistant to clarify ideas, structure arguments and learn new topics.

points.quote: The library provides guidance on how to correctly cite and reference Generative AI in this guide as well as in each of the citation style guides available on our website.
points.gist: The library gives guidance on citing generative AI in this guide and in each citation style guide.
